api_list.name: Manager data
api_list.description: Returns manager data
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://sportscore1.p.rapidapi.com/managers/1"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "sportscore1.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

import requests

url = "https://sportscore1.p.rapidapi.com/seasons/1/standings-tables"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "sportscore1.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

import requests

url = "https://sportscore1.p.rapidapi.com/seasons/{id}/standings-tables"
